plan.title: RFQ bid refused after countdown ends

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage project so the RFQ stage can be selected.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add a line item for the vendor bid sheet.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Create the shortest supported bidding window; the catalog cannot configure one minute.
Invite the QA vendor who will attempt the late submission.
Publish the RFQ so it is available in the vendor portal.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Wait for the bidding countdown to expire without placing a bid.
Move to the vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the published RFQ from the vendor's event list and enter its pricing view.
Verify that submitting after the countdown ends is refused rather than recording a bid.
Verify the vendor cannot use the submission control after the round has ended.
